extracted.intended_audience: senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH-style biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare an NIH-format biographical sketch for senior/key personnel or other significant contributors, following the provided A–D section structure and the five-page limit. Includes required header fields, education/training table, personal statement, positions/honors, contributions to science, and research support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the prescribed biosketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the A–D section layout (A. Personal Statement; B. Positions and Honors; C. Contributions to Science; D. Research Support). Keep each individual's entire biographical sketch within five pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required header fields
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME; eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login); POSITION TITLE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place these fields at the top of the biosketch for each person so the reviewer can identify the individual and their eRA Commons credential and current position title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training section content and table format
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a table with columns: INSTITUTION AND LOCATION; DEGREE (if applicable); Completion Date MM/YYYY; FIELD OF STUDY. Start with baccalaureate and include subsequent training (masters, residencies, postdocs, fellowships). Add or delete rows as needed to reflect an individual's training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal Statement section describing the individual's qualifications and relevance to the proposed project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise narrative summarizing experience, leadership roles, mentoring/training activities, prior grant/project roles, and why the individual's background makes them well suited to support the proposed project. Use concrete examples (e.g., numbers trained, roles on related grants) as shown in the examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Employment
rubrics_metrics.description: Chronological listing of positions and employment with dates and titles (e.g., Intern Doctor, Program Director, Associate Professor, Dean, Principal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List positions with start/end years and institutional affiliation. Include major administrative roles, deanships, department leadership, and service appointments. Include honors and memberships related to professional service in this section or in accompanying honors listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Experience and Professional Memberships
rubrics_metrics.description: List memberships, board service, committee roles, and other professional experiences with dates (e.g., Board Member, Chair, Member of advisory committees).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include sustained professional service (boards, advisory committees, national councils) and roles that demonstrate leadership, relevance, and contributions to the field; provide dates to indicate duration of service.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contributions to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative descriptions of major scientific contributions with supporting cited publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each major contribution, provide a brief narrative that explains the context, findings, and significance (policy or practice impact where relevant). Follow each narrative with representative citations (journal, year, volume/pages, and PMIDs/PMCIDs where available). Number contributions and include multiple representative publications per contribution as exemplified on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support (Ongoing, Pending, and Completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: List ongoing and completed research support with grant numbers, project titles, dates, and the individual's role (e.g., PI, Co-Investigator, PD).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate ongoing, pending, and completed support. For each entry include: grant number, funding agency, project title/brief description, project dates, and explicit role designation (Role: PI / Co-Investigator / PD / Co-PI / MPI, etc.). Provide short descriptions of study aims or responsibilities if relevant to demonstrate expertise and workload.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide links to full publication lists when available
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a URL to a complete bibliography or MyNCBI/Publications list where applicable (e.g., 'Publications: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/myncbi/.../bibliography/...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the applicant maintains an online complete publication list (MyNCBI or similar), include the link to allow reviewers to access the full record beyond the representative citations in Contributions to Science.
